name: version-sentinel
description: Warns about dependency version checks and recommends upstream verification. Never blocks tools.

disable.title: Turn off Version Sentinel (kill switch)
disable.description: Default: false — advisory warnings are active. Set true to suppress hook warnings. Hooks never block tools even when enabled. VS_DISABLE in your shell overrides this setting.

window_hours.title: How long a recorded version check stays valid (hours)
window_hours.description: Default: 24 hours (minimum 1, maximum 168). Expired checks can produce advisory warnings; work remains allowed. Lower it for more frequent reminders or raise it to reuse evidence longer.
